text:
Which statement is true of all neutral atoms?
A
The number of electrons equals the number of nucleons.
B
The number of neutrons equals the number of protons.
C
The number of nucleons equals the number of neutrons.
D
The number of protons equals the number of electrons.

options.label: A
options.text: The number of electrons equals the number of nucleons.

options.label: B
options.text: The number of neutrons equals the number of protons.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of nucleons equals the number of neutrons.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of protons equals the number of electrons.
